title: H² of squares in a 2-plane and local finiteness of H²⌞Q
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P with dim Q = 2, and a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0. Let ν₀ := H²⌞Q (μHE[2].restrict Q). Then ν₀ is finite on compact sets, and for every r with 0 ≤ r ≤ 2: ν₀({w : |w| < 3, |⟨w, a⟩| < r, |⟨w, e⟩| < r}) = 4r² and ν₀({w : |w| ≤ 3, |⟨w, a⟩| ≤ r, |⟨w, e⟩| ≤ r}) = 4r² (both as ENNReal.ofReal (4r²)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts (μHE[2].restrict (Q : Set (Euclid P))) ∧ ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 2 → μHE[2].restrict (Q : Set (Euclid P)) {w : Euclid P | ‖w‖ < 3 ∧ |inner ℝ w a| < r ∧ |inner ℝ w e| < r} = ENNReal.ofReal (4 * r ^ 2) ∧ μHE[2].restrict (Q : Set (Euclid P)) {w : Euclid P | ‖w‖ ≤ 3 ∧ |inner ℝ w a| ≤ r ∧ |inner ℝ w e| ≤ r} = ENNReal.ofReal (4 * r ^ 2)
